description: This file defines a WebDavServlet class that extends GenericServlet to handle WebDAV requests within the OFBiz framework. It initializes dependencies like Delegator, Dispatcher, Security, and a RequestHandlerFactory, and forwards HTTP requests to appropriate handlers.

classes.name: WebDavServlet
classes.description: A servlet that handles WebDAV requests by delegating to a RequestHandler obtained from a factory, with initialization of security and dispatcher components.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the servlet, setting up delegator, dispatcher, security, and request handler factory based on context parameters.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Handles incoming requests by setting attributes, delegating to a request handler, and invalidating the session.
